Palette

/PAL-it/ - the stress falls on PAL · noun

Hear It

What It Means

Palette means a range of colors or qualities.

Autumn narrows the garden's palette to copper, ochre, and one late violet.

Worked Example

The ceramicist spent a decade with a two-glaze palette, celadon and iron black, then shocked the craft fair by adding a hot chrome yellow — and collectors argued all season about whether the wider range was still her.

Palette is exact because it names the set of colors an artist allows herself, not any single shade. One glaze is just a color; the chosen family of colors a body of work draws from — narrow or wide — is a palette.

How Strong Is It? — hue → scheme → palette

hue vs. palette

hue vs. palette: A hue is a single color — one note where a palette is the whole chord; it sits far below a palette in reach.

scheme vs. palette

scheme vs. palette: A scheme goes further than a single hue — a chosen plan of a few colors — but still stops short of a palette, the full range at an artist's command.

Sort It Out

Now place each word on the right side of palette.

Build the Word

The pieces

Root — pal-

Root — pal-: flat blade, spade (Latin pala)

Suffix — -ette

Suffix — -ette: small, little

Put it together

Put it together: Pal- (flat blade) + -ette (little) = a little flat blade. French palette first named the painter's thin thumb-board, the 'little blade' colors are mixed on; the board's name then slid onto the colors themselves, so a palette now means the whole range a work draws from.

Why there's no relative to spot

Why there's no relative to spot: Latin pala, the flat-blade word inside palette, built no other common English vocabulary — its family stayed behind in the toolshed languages of Latin and French. What English kept instead is the little board's name, promoted to mean a whole range of colors.

Strength Check

Word Choice

neutral / arts register

Palette is the range in use — a film's palette, a composer's palette of timbres, even a chef's palette of flavors. Spelling is the trap: palate is the roof of your mouth (and your sense of taste), and pallet is a shipping platform. If you mean the artist's set of colors, or any range of qualities, it is palette.
